coordinate_sources.retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS download of current accession mmCIF files
coordinate_sources.integrity: Per-file SHA-256 and byte length are pinned in catalog and model files
coordinate_sources.transformations: None; sources/mmcif files are byte-identical downloads

benchmark_source.citation: Spiliotopoulos A, et al. dMM-PBSA: A New HADDOCK Scoring Function for Protein-Peptide Docking. Front Mol Biosci. 2016;3:46.
benchmark_source.legacy_transcription_lineage: The case labels and paper-score transcription originated in the predecessor repository's spiliotopoulos2016_dmm_pbsa data tables; no machine-specific path is part of this portable validation record.
benchmark_source.audit_boundary: Labels were inherited from the local v1 transcription; current RCSB sources were independently hash-pinned, but the paper HADDOCK endpoint protocol is not reproduced here.

excluded_legacy_material.note: Legacy paths are provenance references only.
